edges: Koalas are threatened by habitat loss and climate change.
Koalas are affected by pollution and urban development.
The koala's only food source, the eucalyptus tree, has declined.
Koalas are killed by cars, especially in wildlife sanctuaries.
Koalas are also killed by poachers.
Captive koalas must be weighed daily to ensure proper feeding.
A request for a koala to meet the Queen was refused.
London Zoo no longer has koalas.
A female koala at London Zoo died of cancer caused by a retrovirus.
Bushfires pose a threat to koalas.
Climate change is affecting koalas' habitats.
